newsitem.title: UK: BOE'S KING PROJECTS STG INDEX AT 90 IN TWO YEARS.
newsitem.headline: BOE'S KING PROJECTS STG INDEX AT 90 IN TWO YEARS.

text.p: Bank of England deputy governor Mervyn King said on Wednesday that central bank's August inflation report projected sterling's trade weighted index at 90 in two years' time.
The sterling weighted index on Wednesday was quoted at 101.5.
"We have assumed that a good part of the exchange rate rise over the last year will unwind over the next two years," King said at a news conference after release of the report.
He said the central projection implied interest rate differentials will lead sterling to fall back and also some of the erratic effects will unwind.
"Our central projection is based on the view that the effective exchange rate for sterling will fall back to about 90 two years from now," he said.
"That's quite a substantial fall," he added. "One of the downside risks to the forecast is that sterling may not fall back to that level."
King said he expected sterling to fall steadily to that level over the two year period.
